# Compute most common genre per playlist
from collections import Counter

new_titles = {}
for pid, details in playlist_details.items():
    genres = [song_genres[s['id']] for s in details['songs']]
    counter = Counter(genres)
    most_common = counter.most_common(1)[0][0]
    new_title = f"{details['title']} | {most_common}"
    new_titles[pid] = new_title
    print(f"Playlist {pid}: {details['title']} -> {new_title}")
